parameters.description: ID of the model to get.
parameters.name: model_id

400.description: Bad request. The request is invalid or an invalid API key is provided.

summary: Get information about a model with its model_id, including pricing.

Model.description:
OpenAI-compatible model response returned by `/v1/models`.
Includes optional pricing fields populated based on the model type.

aliases.description: Alias ID(s) of the model that user can use in a request's model field.

cached_prompt_text_token_price.description: Price of a prompt text token (in USD cents per 100 million tokens) that was cached previously.

cached_prompt_text_token_price_long_cont.description: Price of the cached prompt text token for long context requests (USD cents per 100 million tokens).

completion_text_token_price.description: Price of the completion text token in USD cents per 100 million tokens.

completion_text_token_price_long_context.description: Price of the completion text token for long context requests (USD cents per 100 million tokens).

context_length.description: The maximum context length supported by the model, in tokens.

created.description: Model creation time in Unix timestamp.

image_price.description:
Price per image in USD cents (image generation models).
The default tier: medium quality at the default (1k) resolution. See
`pricing` for the full quality/resolution matrix.

long_context_threshold.description: Token count at or above which the long context prices apply.

object.description: The object type, which is always `"model"`.

pricing.description:
Per-image prices by (quality, resolution) tier (image generation
models). Omitted when the model prices all qualities identically
(see `image_price`).

prompt_image_token_price.description: Price of the prompt image token in USD cents per 100 million tokens.

prompt_text_token_price.description: Price of the prompt text token in USD cents per 100 million tokens.

prompt_text_token_price_long_context.description: Price of the prompt text token for long context requests (USD cents per 100 million tokens).

ImagePricingTier.description:
Per-image price for one (quality, resolution) tier of an image generation
model.

price_per_image.description: Price per generated image, in 1/100,000,000ths of a USD cent.

quality.description:
Quality tier this price applies to: `"low"`, `"medium"`, or `"high"`.
Medium is the default quality a request serves at when it leaves
`quality` unset.

resolution.description:
Output resolution this price applies to: `"1k"` or `"2k"`. 1k is the
default when a request leaves `resolution` unset.
